title: group chat all-or-nothing host policy breaks entire group if one member missing
description: crates/kith-chat/src/message.rs: group chat loop uses .ok_or_else()?  on each member's host lookup. If ANY member has no mailbox_host (e.g. was added to chat_members but contact record has no host), the entire Message/set send fails with serverFail. Old behavior: silently skip members with no host (best-effort fan-out). New behavior: all-or-nothing — one bad contact blocks all senders in the group. This will generate user reports: 'group chat stopped working' with no obvious fix. Phase 1 is 1:1 only so this does not bite today, but group chat rows exist and users can create them. Policy decision should be explicit before group chat is advertised.
